title: $D^2$-OPD: Separating Direction and Distance in Extrapolative On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07241v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model to match a teacher's next-token distributions on student-generated prefixes. Extrapolative OPD further extends the teacher's log-probability shift relative to a reference policy to construct stronger learning targets. However, existing methods couple extrapolation direction and distance, allowing the magnitude of the teacher's shift to dictate how far the target moves. We propose $D^2$-OPD, decoupling these two factors: a per-prefix hard KL constraint bounds the target's distance from the teacher, while an adaptive combination of the teacher's post-training shift and the initial student--teacher gap determines the extrapolation direction. We optimize the student toward this target using forward KL, providing learning signals even for low-probability tokens. We evaluate three settings: where standard OPD performs well, where it struggles with base-model initialization, and where no tea

translated_title: D²-OPD：在外推式在线策略蒸馏中分离方向与距离
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）训练学生模型在学生生成的前缀上匹配教师模型的下一个词元分布。外推式OPD进一步扩展教师相对于参考策略的对数概率偏移，以构建更强的学习目标。然而，现有方法将外推方向与距离耦合在一起，使得教师偏移的幅度直接决定目标移动的远近。我们提出D²-OPD，将这两个因素解耦：通过针对每个前缀的硬KL约束来限制目标与教师之间的距离，同时由教师训练后偏移与初始师生差距的自适应组合来决定外推方向。我们使用前向KL散度将学生模型优化至该目标，即使对低概率词元也能提供学习信号。我们在三种设置下进行评估：标准OPD表现良好的设置、标准OPD在基础模型初始化下表现不佳的设置，以及没有教……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: D²-OPD通过解耦外推方向与距离来改进外推式在线策略蒸馏——用每前缀硬KL约束限制目标与教师的距离，并用教师训练后偏移与初始师生差距的自适应组合确定外推方向，从而在多种场景下提供更稳健的学习信号。
en_tdlr: D²-OPD improves extrapolative on-policy distillation by decoupling direction and distance: a per-prefix hard KL constraint bounds the target's distance from the teacher, while an adaptive combination of the teacher's post-training shift and the initial student-teacher gap determines the extrapolation direction.
